程序包 org.bukkit.generator

接口 LimitedRegion

所有超级接口:
FeatureFlagSetHolder, net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed, Keyed, RegionAccessor
public interface LimitedRegion extends RegionAccessor
有限区域用于世界生成中跨越区块的特性，例如树木或矿石. 使用 getBuffer() 来了解你可以超出中心区块多少. 缓冲区可能已经填充，也可能尚未填充. 坐标是相对于世界原点的绝对坐标.

原文： A limited region is used in world generation for features which are going over a chunk. For example, trees or ores. Use getBuffer() to know how much you can go beyond the central chunk. The buffer zone may or may not be already populated. The coordinates are absolute from the world origin.

  • 方法详细资料

    • getBuffer

      int getBuffer()
      获取中心区块周围可访问的缓冲区大小. 返回值采用正常的世界坐标比例.

      原文： Gets the buffer around the central chunk which is accessible. The returned value is in normal world coordinate scale.

      For example: If the method returns 16 you have a working area of 48x48.

      返回:
      X和Z方向上的缓冲区大小

      原文：The buffer in X and Z direction

    • isInRegion

      boolean isInRegion(@NotNull @NotNull Location location)
      检查给定的 Location 是否在区域内.

      原文： Checks if the given Location is in the region.

      参数:
      location - 要检查的位置

      原文：the location to check

      返回:
      如果位置在区域内则返回true，否则返回false

      原文：true if the location is in the region, otherwise false.
